notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
✦ NEW CONTENT
Warning signs on loading screens
Each level now displays an icon representing its main type of death. Consider it a warning... or a promise.

New “J” key function
Pressing J now shows your current floor.
It wastes your time.

✦ GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS
Module interface adjustments
The module configuration option has been repositioned for better accessibility.

Additional text in the training area
Extra prompts have been added to help new players understand the environment and basic mechanics more easily.

✦ OTHER CHANGES
Minor text corrections.

Subtle improvement to level transition flow.

Internal preparation for future content.
(The creation systems have not been activated. Yet.)

Thank you for continuing to be part of the experiment.
– Safe Zone Corp
